name: blindqa
description: Human-like QA for any web app: Playwright drives it like a person on whatever browser this machine has (local, headless, CDP, n.eko, Orca), scripts re-test only what code changes touch, Jev makes small judgment calls, and nothing it writes ever reaches a git remote.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe (Jev) API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Key for api.typesafe.ai. Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY from your environment or ~/.blindqa/.env.

typesafe_model.title: Jev model
typesafe_model.description: Pin a version (e.g. jev-1.13) so two runs differ only because the app changed.
